Countries of the World data and image sources

Country names, capitals, and currencies
REST Countries project data snapshot
https://github.com/restcountries/restcountries

Largest-city selection
GeoNames cities15000 data, licensed under CC BY 4.0
https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/
https://www.geonames.org/about.html

Country boundary geometry
Natural Earth Admin 0 Countries, public domain
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/

San Marino high-detail boundary
geoBoundaries Database (www.geoboundaries.org)
https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/SMR/ADM0/

Flag artwork
flag-icons, MIT License
https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons
